info.title: TV API
info.description: Complaint & Inquiry Tracking System REST API

post.summary: Register a new user. Optionally assign a role (Admin only).
Authenticate a user with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

get.summary: Get current authenticated user's profile.

List candidates (applications) with optional filters and pagination.
Filters: candidateName, jobId, categoryId, statusId, dateFrom (HiringDate), dateTo (HiringDate).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

post.summary:
Create a new candidate with initial status and security clearance.
Optionally upload a CV file and/or a profile image.

get.summary:
Get a single candidate by ID with full details.
Returns: profile image, CV file, job info, all interview scores (HR / Technical / Overall),
hiring probability, ranking position among same-job candidates, and current status.

put.summary: Update a candidate's basic info (name, job, reasons, CV, profile image).

get.summary: Update only the application status for a candidate (e.g. Under Vetting, Approved, Rejected).

patch.summary: Update only the security clearance status for a candidate (e.g. In Check, Cleared, Denied).
Update interview grade for a candidate (e.g. HR or Technical).

get.summary:
Extract structured data from a candidate's CV PDF file.
Returns: Skills, Experience, Languages, Certificates, Education.

Returns the hiring pipeline progress for a candidate.
Steps: Application → HR Evaluation → Technical Evaluation → Offer → Security Clearance → Hired.
Each step returns: stepName, completed (bool), status (Completed/InProgress/Pending), date, detail.
If the candidate is Hired, all steps are forced to Completed.

Returns a ranked list of all candidates for a specific job.
Ordered by their Overall Score (descending).
Retrieve all job categories with pagination and filtering.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

post.summary: Create a new category. Admin or HR required.

get.summary: Get a single category by ID.

put.summary: Update an existing category. Admin or HR required.

get.summary: Admin dashboard with aggregated statistics: total candidates, jobs, users, interviews, and breakdowns by status, security clearance, job, and process progress.
Process dashboard showing all phases (or a single phase) with their processes, average completion, and overall progress.

parameters.name: phaseId
parameters.description: Optional phase ID to filter results to a single phase.

get.summary: Get process statistics: total, active, completed counts, average completion percentage, breakdown by status and phase.
Get issue statistics: total, resolved, unresolved counts, breakdown by resolved status, process, and priority.
Get phase statistics: total phases, each phase with its process progress.
Recruitment funnel: counts of candidates at each stage (total, HR interview, technical interview, offers sent, accepted, hired).
Job status: each job with its title, number of open positions, and count of applicants.
Risk management issues: list of all issues with their name, priority, and resolved status.
Summary cards: Open Positions, Candidates Pipe, Open Risks.

post.summary: Import candidates from an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. Each imported candidate gets the default Pending process status and is logged.

get.summary: List all interviews with full details.
Get a single interview by ID.
Get all interviews for a specific candidate.
Get interviews for a candidate filtered by type (HR or Technical).
List all issues with optional filters by name, priority, process ID, date, or resolved status.

post.summary: Create a new issue for a process.

requestBody.description: Issue details including name, process ID, and optional resolved/date.

get.summary: Get statistics for all risks/issues including total count and percentages by priority.
Get top 5 unresolved issues ordered by priority (Critical first).
Get a single issue by ID.
Get all issues associated with a specific process.

patch.summary: Toggle the resolved status of an issue.

get.summary: List all jobs with their category names. Optionally filter by title, category, creation date, or location.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional search keyword for job title.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional date filter — returns jobs created on or after this date.

post.summary: Create a new job. Accepts location, employment type, open positions, and target hiring date.

get.summary: Get job statistics counts: total jobs, open positions, applications, offers sent.
Get a single job by ID with its category name and all new fields.

put.summary: Update an existing job including location, employment type, open positions, and target hiring date.

get.summary: List all candidate application statuses (e.g. Under Vetting, Approved, Rejected).

post.summary: Create a new application status. Admin only.

get.summary: Get a single application status by ID.

put.summary: Update an application status name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Delete an application status. Admin only.

get.summary: List all security clearance statuses (e.g. In Check, Cleared, Denied).

post.summary: Create a new security clearance status. Admin only.

get.summary: Get a single security clearance status by ID.

put.summary: Update a security clearance status name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Delete a security clearance status. Admin only.

get.summary: List all interview types (e.g. HR, Technical).

post.summary: Create a new interview type. Admin only.

get.summary: Get a single interview type by ID.

put.summary: Update an interview type name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Delete an interview type. Admin only.

get.summary: List all process phases.

post.summary: Create a new phase. Admin only.

get.summary: Get a single phase by ID.

put.summary: Update a phase name. Admin only.

get.summary: List all process statuses (Pending, InProgress, Completed, Holded).

post.summary: Create a new process status with a completion percentage. Admin only.

get.summary: Get a single process status by ID.

put.summary: Update a process status name and percentage. Admin only.

delete.summary: Delete a process status. Admin only.

get.summary: Returns offer status counts for the dashboard summary cards.

Returns a paged, filtered list of offers.
Filters: candidateName, offerStatusId, categoryId, jobId, dateFrom, dateTo.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

post.summary:
Creates a new offer for a candidate.
Automatically moves the candidate's status to "In Offer".

get.summary: Returns the full offer preview including candidate summary and rank.

put.summary: Updates an existing offer's details (salary, start date, expiry date, benefits).

patch.summary:
Marks the offer as Accepted.
Automatically moves the candidate's status to "Hired".

Marks the offer as Declined.
Automatically moves the candidate's status to "Rejected".

Marks the offer as Expired.
Automatically moves the candidate's status back to "In Process".

post.summary: Create a new phase. Admin only.

get.summary: List all phases with their associated processes and progress.
Get a single phase by ID with its processes.
List all processes with full details including dependencies and issues.

post.summary: Create a new process with Pending status by default. Admin or HR required.

requestBody.description: Process data including name, dates, and phase ID.

get.summary: Get a single process by ID with its dependencies and issues.

put.summary: Update a process including its phase and process status. Admin or HR required.

patch.summary: Replace all dependencies for a process. Pass an empty list to clear dependencies. Admin or HR required.

requestBody.description: List of process IDs this process depends on.

delete.summary: Remove a single dependency from a process. Admin or HR required.

parameters.name: dependsOnId
parameters.description: The dependency process ID to remove.

patch.summary: Change the status of a process.

get.summary: Get all available process statuses.
List all available roles.
Get a single role by ID.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by account status (Active / Blocked / Locked).

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
How to combine the provided filters.
"AND" (default) — user must satisfy ALL supplied filters.
"OR"            — user must satisfy AT LEAST ONE supplied filter.

get.summary: Get statistics for all users including total counts and percentages.
Get a single user by ID.

post.summary: Create a new user and automatically assign the HR role.

patch.summary:
Set the account status of a user (Active / Blocked / Locked).
Setting to Active also resets the failed login attempt counter.

AccountStatus.description: Represents the account status of an application user.

lastLoginAt.description: UTC timestamp of this user's last successful login (null on first login).

CandidateDetailDto.description:
Rich single-candidate response for GET /api/candidates/{id}.
Includes computed analytics: overall score, ranking, hiring probability.

CandidateDtoPagedResult.description: Generic paged result returned by list endpoints that support pagination.

CandidatePipelineDto.description: Full pipeline progress for a candidate — returned by GET /api/candidates/{id}/pipeline.

CandidatePipelineStepDto.description:
Represents a single step in the candidate hiring pipeline.
Status: "Completed" | "InProgress" | "Pending"

CategoryDtoPagedResult.description: Generic paged result returned by list endpoints that support pagination.

CreateOfferDto.description: Request body for creating a new offer.

InterviewSummaryDto.description: Single interview summary used inside CandidateDetailDto.

IssuePriority.description:
Represents the priority level of an issue.
Stored as int in the database.

OfferDto.description: Full offer details — used for list rows and offer preview.

OfferDtoPagedResult.description: Generic paged result returned by list endpoints that support pagination.

OfferPreviewDto.description: Richer offer preview panel — includes candidate summary fields shown in the UI.

OfferStatusSummaryDto.description: Dashboard stats counts for each offer status.

PatchCandidateSecurityDto.description: PATCH body to update only the candidate security clearance status.

PatchCandidateStatusDto.description: PATCH body to update only the candidate application status.

ProcessDependencyDto.description:
Payload for PATCH /api/processes/{id}/dependencies.
Replaces the full dependency list for the given process.
Pass an empty list to clear all dependencies.

role.description: Optional role to assign on registration (e.g. "Admin", "HR").

UpdateOfferDto.description: Request body for updating an existing offer's details.

UpdateUserStatusDto.description: Payload for admin to change a user's account status.

UserSearchResultDto.description:
Flat search-result DTO returned by GET /api/users/search.
Contains only the fields relevant for the user list view.
